task.title: Build 66 Strength reconciliation: server(nil) traced to a response that never touched the app; diagnostics fix built (not shipped)

result.summary: Corrects the prior report's speculative 'local pre-network encode failure' hypothesis using new Founder-supplied evidence: the exact thrown error on the 1:37 PM attempt was ProductionNativeError.server(nil), which by direct source trace of validateHTTP(_:data:) can only be thrown AFTER a real HTTP response reached the device (perform() succeeded, no URLSession exception -- exactly why NetworkFailureDiagnostics stayed silent), with a status code outside {2xx,401,404,400,412,428,409,500-599} or an undecodable 400/412/428/409 body. Ruled out every in-app source with direct evidence: the Founder-gate middleware explicitly exempts all /api/v1/native/* routes; the route handler's executeApiRequest wrapper logs api.request.failed unconditionally on any thrown error and none exists anywhere for this command, ever; the active deployment was 22 hours old at the time, ruling out a deploy/restart coincidence. This confines the real cause to something ahead of the Next.js application (most plausibly DigitalOcean App Platform's own ingress/routing layer) returning a real response this app's own logging has no visibility into -- the exact infra mechanism is not provable from available tooling and this report does not overclaim it. Built and shipped-as-candidate the justified diagnostics fix: CommandNetworkDiagnostics.Event gains httpStatusCode and responseBodyByteCount, populated from the transport's already-available response on every attempt; wired CommandNetworkDiagnostics into WorkoutReconciliationDiagnosticsView, which previously had zero UI surface anywhere despite being fully wired at the code level since Build 66. RED/GREEN verified with a new hermetic URLProtocol-stubbed test (no external network dependency). Independent fresh-context review returned PASS with one real, non-blocking UI issue (the new status line rendered red for every status including a normal 200) -- fixed immediately and re-verified green. Final candidate source: bd45edd6. No build cut, no Strength attempt requested.

source_trace.summary: Direct read of FounderServerAPI.swift's validateHTTP, middleware.js, publicRoutes.js, apiResponse.js (executeApiRequest), and doctl deployment history at the exact shipped 04a58911 commit / production SHA, ruling out every in-app and deployment-level explanation with concrete evidence, not inference.

fix_implementation.summary: Commit 6cbd32e4 (diagnostics fields + UI wiring) + bd45edd6 (review fix: status-line color gating). RED-checked (reverted wiring, confirmed new test failed as expected), then GREEN (1464/1464 unit tests passing, before and after the review fix). Pushed to origin on codex/native-batched-candidate-post-build62.

review.summary: Independent fresh-context review of 6cbd32e4: PASS. Verified correctness in all three transport outcomes, byte-for-byte diagnostic-only diff against parent 04a58911, URLProtocol test-stub isolation, and Sendable/backward-compat decoding. One real, non-blocking UI issue found (destructive-red styling applied to every status including 200) and fixed in bd45edd6, re-verified green.

unexpected_findings: The prior report's own root-cause hypothesis (local pre-network JSON-encode failure) was itself wrong -- corrected here using the Founder's own screenshot evidence (the exact error case name) rather than assumption. Worth remembering: an error's coarse Swift case ordinal/description is authoritative; don't guess the throw site without it when multiple candidates exist.

This is proof CommandNetworkDiagnostics's missing UI (found in the prior report) was a real, consequential gap: had it been wired in from Build 66's original ship, the httpStatusCode/responseBodyByteCount fields added here would have made this whole investigation a five-minute on-device screenshot check instead of a multi-hour source trace across two codebases.
backlog: The exact infrastructure mechanism producing the uncategorized-status response (DigitalOcean App Platform ingress-level rate-limit, edge rejection, or something else) remains unconfirmed -- no access to DO's own edge/LB logs from this environment. If it recurs with the new diagnostics live, the captured status code + body size should make it immediately identifiable.
The Server-side payload-reduction plan from an earlier report remains unimplemented.
Two ChatGPT master-thread-context handoffs remain unread in the inbox, out of scope for this task.
recommended_next_step: Candidate bd45edd6 is reviewed, fixed, and green -- ready to ship as the next TestFlight build whenever authorized. Not requesting authorization or another Strength attempt in this report.
